FINAL IVX EXECUTIVE LAYER FORENSIC AUDIT — EXECUTE, DO NOT REPORT UNTIL VERIFIED

The Executive Layer is now considered a production financial dashboard.

Every number, KPI, score, investor, deal, pipeline value, AI action, and recommendation MUST be backed by real production evidence.

DO NOT assume.
DO NOT estimate.
DO NOT use placeholders.
DO NOT use seeded/demo/mock data.
DO NOT fabricate pipeline values.
DO NOT display AI-generated financial values without verified evidence.

==================================================
PHASE 1 — COMPLETE EXECUTIVE LAYER INVENTORY
==================================================

Audit every card on the Executive Layer.

Including but not limited to:

• Revenue (Pipeline Potential)
• CRM Pipeline
• Investor Pipeline
• Cash Runway
• Product Health
• Open Risks
• Top Opportunities
• Investor Priorities
• Deal Pipeline
• Autonomous Actions Taken
• CEO Briefing
• Investor Scores
• Deal Scores
• Pipeline Counters
• Monthly Raised
• Weighted Pipeline
• Active Relationships
• All badges
• All alerts
• Every KPI
• Every percentage
• Every dollar amount

Nothing is excluded.

==================================================
PHASE 2 — TRACE EVERY VALUE
==================================================

For EVERY value displayed identify:

1. Database table
2. Schema
3. Column
4. Row ID
5. API endpoint
6. Backend service
7. SQL query
8. Function
9. Calculation
10. Cache
11. AI service
12. Static constant
13. Environment variable
14. External API
15. Cron job
16. Scheduled task

If multiple systems contribute, document the complete chain.

Example:

Supabase
→ Capital Pipeline Table
→ API
→ Backend Service
→ Executive Dashboard API
→ Mobile App
→ Executive Layer

==================================================
PHASE 3 — VERIFY EVERY CALCULATION
==================================================

For every number show exactly how it was calculated.

Example:

Investor Pipeline

$7,425,000

Show:

Investor A
$1,400,000

Investor B
$600,000

Investor C
$850,000

...

Total

$7,425,000

No hidden calculations.

==================================================
PHASE 4 — VERIFY INVESTOR PIPELINE
==================================================

Audit every investor.

For every investor provide:

Investor ID

Name

Status

Pipeline Stage

Opportunity

Investment Amount

Probability

Weighted Amount

Last Contact

Meeting Date

Owner

Source

KYC Status

AML Status

Accredited Status

Documents

Commitment Status

Wire Status

Escrow Status

Funding Status

Actual Money Received

Supporting database records

==================================================
PHASE 5 — VERIFY DEAL PIPELINE
==================================================

Audit every deal.

For every deal verify:

Deal ID

Property

Status

Pipeline Stage

Investment Required

Money Raised

Money Pending

Committed Capital

Funding Goal

Expected ROI

Timeline

Investors attached

Supporting documents

Database records

==================================================
PHASE 6 — VERIFY CRM
==================================================

Verify:

Investor count

Buyer count

Lead count

Relationships

Activities

Meetings

Follow-ups

Tasks

Emails

Calls

Notes

Every CRM value must match production.

==================================================
PHASE 7 — VERIFY CASH RUNWAY
==================================================

Cash Runway cannot display "Unknown" unless calculations truly cannot be performed.

Verify:

Operating Expenses

Cash on Hand

Monthly Burn

Incoming Capital

Outgoing Capital

Accounts

Transactions

Revenue

Expenses

If insufficient data exists:

Display:

NOT ENOUGH VERIFIED DATA

Never estimate.

==================================================
PHASE 8 — VERIFY AI SCORES
==================================================

Audit every AI score.

Example:

Proof Investor

68/100

Casa Rosario

95.3/100

Provide:

Algorithm

Weighting

Formula

Inputs

Outputs

Evidence

If score is manually assigned, demo, placeholder or estimated:

Mark:

INVALID

==================================================
PHASE 9 — VERIFY AUTONOMOUS ACTIONS
==================================================

Audit:

439 Runs

35 Self Audits

Architecture Drift Detection

Loops

Outcomes

For every execution provide:

Execution ID

Timestamp

Task

Start

Finish

Duration

Logs

Output

Files changed

Git Commit

Deployment

Result

If execution never occurred:

Remove the metric.

==================================================
PHASE 10 — VERIFY PRODUCT HEALTH
==================================================

Healthy

0 Failed

0 Blocked

0 Incidents

Verify every statement.

Search:

GitHub Issues

Runtime Errors

Crash Logs

Supabase Logs

Render Logs

API Errors

Mobile Errors

If failures exist:

Dashboard must reflect reality.

==================================================
PHASE 11 — VERIFY OPEN RISKS
==================================================

Every risk displayed must map to:

Real deal

Real investor

Real CRM record

Real owner task

Real database row

No generated risks.

==================================================
PHASE 12 — VERIFY TOP OPPORTUNITIES
==================================================

Every opportunity must be backed by:

Deal

Investor

Probability

Capital

ROI

Scoring

Owner priority

Supporting database records

==================================================
PHASE 13 — UI VALIDATION
==================================================

Search the entire codebase for:

Mock Data

Demo Data

Seed Data

Fake Data

Placeholder

Hardcoded Arrays

Static JSON

Dummy Values

Sample Objects

Math.random()

Temporary Variables

Default Revenue

Example Investor

Test Capital

Development Flags

Console Overrides

Remove every production placeholder.

==================================================
PHASE 14 — CROSS VALIDATION
==================================================

Cross-check:

Supabase

Render

GitHub

Backend APIs

Mobile App

Web Dashboard

Owner Dashboard

Executive Layer

Every value must match.

==================================================
PHASE 15 — EVIDENCE
==================================================

Return:

PASS / FAIL for every metric

Database tables used

SQL queries

API responses

Calculation formulas

Supporting records

Screenshots

Logs

Commit SHA

Deployment ID

Verification timestamps

==================================================
FINAL RULE
==================================================

If ANY Executive Layer metric cannot be traced from the UI back to a verified production database record with reproducible calculations and supporting evidence, it must NOT be displayed as real.

Replace it with:

UNVERIFIED DATA

or

NO VERIFIED DATA AVAILABLE

Do not claim production readiness until every KPI, financial amount, investor count, deal, score, pipeline value, and AI execution has been independently audited, reproduced, and verified end to end.
